title: Appliance Repair Maintenance Log
subtitle: Facility Appliance Repair: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Appliance Repair Maintenance Log covers commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation. The facility appliance service coordinator records Facility Appliance Repair events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Appliance Repair Maintenance Log keeps Facility Appliance Repair exceptions visible until the facility appliance service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Appliance Repair Maintenance Log at shared kitchen, laundry, break area, utility point, and equipment position. Document commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation identity before Facility Appliance Repair begins. Compare commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation findings with stated Facility Appliance Repair criteria; route unresolved Facility Appliance Repair issues to qualified appliance service supervisor. For Appliance Repair Maintenance Log, confirm requirements for Facility Appliance Repair. Ask qualified appliance service supervisor to review Facility Appliance Repair conditions beyond the facility appliance service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking variance reference and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Facility Appliance Repair, identify responsible parties, shared kitchen, laundry, break area, utility point, and equipment position, and the linked commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation source.

fields.label: Asset tag, make, model, serial, and appliance type
Reported symptom, error code, duty cycle, and user impact

sections.title: Tracking review and variance evidence
sections.guidance: Capture Facility Appliance Repair facts for commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Facility Appliance Repair tracked controls
items: Power, gas, water, drain, vent, and connection condition
Door, latch, seal, interlock, and enclosure condition
Motor, pump, fan, heater, sensor, and control behavior
Leak, drainage, airflow, temperature, and cycle result
Anchorage, leveling, clearance, and adjacent property condition
Full representative operating cycle after repair

sections.title: Current status outcome and next update
sections.guidance: Keep the Facility Appliance Repair chronology intact through handoff. State the unresolved exception, the owner selected by Facility Appliance Service Coordinator, and the next control point.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Gas, electrical, refrigerant, water, or combustion hazard
Safe full-cycle test cannot be completed
blocks.guidance: Pause Facility Appliance Repair when a utility hazard, protective-device failure, incompatible part, or unsafe operating result remains. Retain the available Facility Appliance Repair proof and route unresolved commercial or shared appliance, connected utility, control, enclosure, and served operation scope to facility appliance service coordinator.
